evidence: Labeled P2P, adds `src/block_request_tracker.{h,cpp}`, and updates `src/net_processing.cpp` to track and reschedule failed block downloads across peers.
rationale: Adds automated retry handling for on-demand block downloads in net_processing when peers disconnect or stall. The description notes this addresses user issue #27652 because `getblockfrompeer` lacked failure handling, and aids pruned node rescan tracking (#29183).
